description: Introduction and overview of the P-38 Lightning: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The P-38 Lightning is a twin-engine fighter built by Lockheed with a distinctive twin-boom layout, entering service in 1941. Its long range made it the premier Pacific fighter; a P-38 shot down Admiral Yamamoto's aircraft in 1943. 10,037 were built, including photo-reconnaissance versions. Baseline facts: Twin-engine twin-boom fighter; service from 1941; 10,037 built by Lockheed; Pacific long-range ace..
